_about: What an operator's gadget does for the plan, finer than the six roles. Only tags we are confident of; operators listed under _unconfirmed are left untagged until a coach confirms them. Tags: hard-breach (opens reinforced walls/hatches), electric-clear (removes or disables hard-breach denial: Bandit, Kaid, Mute and similar), breach-denial (stops hard breach charges), anti-projectile (stops thrown/launched utility), anti-drone, shield (deployable or carried full shield used to push), smoke (vision denial), flash (blinds), vertical (opens floors/ceilings from above or below), soft-breach (opens soft walls and hatches), intel-cam (remote cameras or sight lines), anti-roam (finds or tracks roamers), trap (hurts or reveals attackers who walk into it), flank-watch (watches or blocks a flank).
